promises.promise: Free and world class government schools in Delhi

evidence_articles.title: Atishi turns spotlight on 'world-class' govt. schools in Delhi; BJP dismisses her claims
evidence_articles.rephrased: The article covers Education Minister Atishi showcasing the Delhi government's work since 2015 to build over 22,000 new classrooms and upgrade infrastructure to world-class standards, while the BJP criticized the claims for ignoring high teacher vacancies and declining pass percentages.
evidence_articles.content: Delhi Education Minister Atishi on Friday claimed that the AAP government has built 22,711 new classrooms in the last nine years, transforming the state of education and providing world-class facilities to students. The BJP dismissed the claims as 'misleading', alleging that the government has failed to fill teacher vacancies and that many schools are functioning without principals.

promises.promise: Free electricity up to 200 units in Delhi

evidence_articles.title: Kejriwal promises free 200 units electricity for tenants
evidence_articles.rephrased: The article covers Arvind Kejriwal's pre-election announcement promising to resolve execution flaws in the prepaid meter scheme so that tenants in Delhi can easily get free electricity up to 200 units and free water.
evidence_articles.content: AAP national convener Arvind Kejriwal on Saturday said that if re-elected, his government will resolve issues regarding the prepaid meter system so that all tenants in Delhi can easily avail themselves of free electricity up to 200 units and water up to 20,000 litres.

evidence_articles.title: Delhi govt working on war footing to clean Yamuna by February 2025: Arvind Kejriwal
evidence_articles.rephrased: The article covers Arvind Kejriwal's announcement of a six-point action plan to clean the heavily polluted Yamuna river to bathing standards by February 2025, which includes increasing sewage treatment capacity and connecting all slums to the sewer network.
evidence_articles.content: Delhi Chief Minister Arvind Kejriwal on Thursday announced a six-point action plan to clean the Yamuna river to 'bathing standards' by February 2025. He said the government is working on a war footing and he is personally monitoring the progress of the projects.

recent_articles.title: Former ED special director Satyabrata Kumar who probed Nirav Modi, Vijay Mallya, takes VRS | Today News
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Satyabrata Kumar**, a former special director of the **Enforcement Directorate (ED)**, has opted for voluntary retirement from government service after nearly 12 years with the agency.  Kumar oversaw high-profile investigations including those involving Nirav Modi, Vijay Mallya, and the Mahadev online betting network. He received approval for voluntary retirement in April and his departure marks the second instance within a year of a senior ED officer leaving government service shortly after exiting the agency. The **ED** arrested Satinder Singh Bhasin, director of Bhasin Infotech and Infrastructure Pvt Ltd, on charges of money laundering related to alleged cheating of home buyers.

recent_articles.title: Abhishek Banerjee attack: Can Mamata Banerjee rebuild INDIA bloc after TMC poll rout? - India Today
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The attack on **Abhishek Banerjee**, nephew of **Mamata Banerjee**, has sparked unexpected support for her from across the Opposition, including **Rahul Gandhi** and **Mallikarjun Kharge**.  This show of solidarity, despite past tensions between the **Trinamool Congress** and other parties like the **Congress**, raises questions about the future of the fractured **INDIA bloc** and its potential to challenge the BJP. The attack has also highlighted the vulnerability of the **Trinamool Congress** after a devastating defeat in the Bengal Assembly elections.

recent_articles.title: Dimpy Dhillon of AAP gets third-time lucky - The Tribune
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Dimpy Dhillon**, a leading transporter, won the Gidderbaha bypoll for **AAP**, defeating his nearest rival, **Amrita Waring** of the Congress.  Dhillon secured 71,644 votes, while Waring received 49,675. The victory marks the first AAP MLA from this constituency and follows a week-long postponement of the election. Dhillon's win is attributed to factors such as his previous losses in the area, public sympathy for him, development initiatives by the state government, and a strong campaign led by **CM Bhagwant Mann** and national convener **Arvind Kejriwal**.

recent_articles.title: Punjab civic polls results: AAP sweeps elections, BJP and Congress win key corporations - India Today
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Aam Aadmi Party (AAP)** swept the Punjab civic body polls, winning 958 of 1,977 municipal wards. The BJP and Congress secured key municipal corporations in Abohar and Kapurthala respectively.  **Bhagwant Mann**, the Punjab Chief Minister, hailed the results as a reflection of public support for his government. However, political analysts cautioned against directly linking the civic poll outcome to the 2027 Assembly polls. Opposition parties accused the AAP government of using official machinery to influence the election.

recent_articles.title: ‘Claims of vishwaguru but...’: Rahul Gandhi, Arvind Kejriwal hit out at PM Modi over CUET-UG exam 2026 delay | Today News
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi**, **Atishi**, and other Opposition leaders criticized the **Narendra Modi** government's handling of the Common University Entrance Test (CUET-UG) 2026 after technical glitches caused disruptions at several examination centers across India.  The **National Testing Agency (NTA)** confirmed that a technical glitch by its service provider, **Tata Consultancy Services (TCS)** delayed the commencement of the exam on May 30th. The agency revised the afternoon shift schedule and provided full duration to morning-session candidates.

recent_articles.title: Abhishek Banerjee heckled | TMC leader Abhishek Banerjee allegedly manhandled by agitating locals at Sonarpur in Bengal's South 24 Parganas: Police - Telegraph India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Abhishek Banerjee**, **Trinamool Congress** national general secretary, was physically attacked by a mob in Sonarpur, West Bengal, while visiting families of post-poll violence victims.  The incident occurred after he arrived to meet the family of Sanju Karmakar, a victim of the violence.  Local residents shouted "thief" slogans and hurled objects at him. **Derek O'Brien**, leader of Trinamool in Rajya Sabha, condemned the attack and called for action from the police. Opposition leaders across parties, including **Samik Bhattacharya** (BJP), **Mallikarjun Kharge** (Congress), **Akhilesh Yadav** (SP), **Arvind Kejriwal** (AAP), and **Tejashwi Yadav** (RJD), condemned the attack on Banerjee and called for an end to political violence.

recent_articles.title: Kejriwal's Claims Of IB Threats Backfire; Call Traced Back To AAP Leader | OdishaBytes
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Aam Aadmi Party (AAP)** and its leader **Arvind Kejriwal** faced embarrassment after allegations of threats by the **Intelligence Bureau (IB)** and police backfired.  **Gujarat Police** arrested two men, including the party's Vadodara city unit president, for allegedly making a "threat call" to an AAP worker posing as an IB official. The investigation stemmed from a social media post by **Kejriwal**, who questioned the harassment of workers in Gujarat. The phone number linked to the alleged threat was traced back to **Nitin Dobriya**, a labor contractor, and his actions were allegedly orchestrated by **Ashok Oza**, the Vadodara unit president.  **Gadhvi**, the Gujarat AAP president, expressed shock at the incident and stated that the party will take appropriate action if connections or responsibilities emerge in Gujarat.

recent_articles.title: BJP accuses Kejriwal of sending voters hoax calls to mislead - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **BJP** accused **Arvind Kejriwal**, leader of the **AAP**, of orchestrating hoax calls to mislead voters and distribute money in slum areas.  **Parvesh Verma**, a BJP MP, played an audio recording of one such call, alleging that the **AAP** is attempting to manipulate voters. The **BJP** also claimed the **AAP** has accessed confidential voter data and accused them of supporting activities that shield terrorism. **Sudhanshu Trivedi**, a BJP spokesperson, welcomed the US Supreme Court's decision to extradite Tahawwur Rana, an accused in the 2008 Mumbai terror attacks.  The **BJP** demanded an investigation into these allegations.

recent_articles.title: INDIA Bloc Revival In Bengal? Support For Mamata Banerjee Over Nephew's Assault
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Despite losing the Bengal election, **Mamata Banerjee**'s stature within the **INDIA** bloc remains strong. Opposition leaders condemned the assault on her nephew, **Abhishek Banerjee**, by a mob in Sonarpur, South 24 Parganas.  **Mallikarjun Kharge**, **Akhilesh Yadav**, and **Arvind Kejriwal** accused the BJP of fostering political violence, while the ruling party denied involvement and blamed the TMC for mischaracterizing public anger. The incident has led to calls for stronger law-and-order measures in West Bengal.

recent_articles.title: ED raids Pinarayi Vijayan's residences in CMRL-Exalogic case - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Enforcement Directorate (ED)** conducted raids on the residences of former Kerala Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan and his daughter, T. Veena, in Kannur and Thiruvananthapuram, alleging that her defunct firm received substantial monthly retainers from **Cochin Minerals and Rutile Limited (CMRL)** between 2017 and 2021 without rendering any tangible service. The raids triggered protests across the state, with CPI(M) activists allegedly vandalizing vehicles carrying ED officials.  The ED is verifying bank transactions of Ms. Veena while stating no incriminating documents were found at Mr. Vijayan's residence.

recent_articles.title: Delhi HC seeks response from AAP’s Gopal Rai, journalist in contempt plea - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Gopal Rai**, an AAP leader, and journalist **Saurav Das** were issued notices by the **Delhi High Court** in response to a petition seeking contempt proceedings against them for allegedly orchestrating a social media campaign against Justice Swarana Kanta Sharma. The petition also named former Chief Minister **Arvind Kejriwal** and ex-AAP MLA **Saurabh Bhardwaj** as parties, alleging that they exerted extra-judicial pressure on the judge through their social media posts.  The court has listed the case for further hearing on August 4th after observing that a contempt case is already underway against **Kejriwal** and others.

recent_articles.title: AAP holds protests against BJP over ED action against Punjab Minister Sanjeev Arora - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Aam Aadmi Party (AAP)** held protests across Punjab against the **BJP** following the ED's arrest of Punjab Industries Minister Sanjeev Arora on charges of GST fraud. The protests, led by AAP leaders including Hardip Singh Mundian and Mohinder Bhagat, escalated into clashes with BJP workers in Ludhiana and Bathinda.  The **BJP** accused AAP workers of attacking their activists while the **AAP** condemned the police's alleged inaction.

recent_articles.title: Kejriwal slams PM Modi over ED raids in Punjab - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **AAP** leader Arvind Kejriwal accused the **ED** of being a tool for political intimidation, targeting Punjab Minister Sanjeev Arora in raids.  Kejriwal claimed that the BJP is trying to break AAP leaders and force them into joining their party, comparing PM Modi's actions to Mughal Emperor Aurangzeb's atrocities. He asserted that the people of Punjab will resist these attacks and teach the BJP a lesson in the 2027 Assembly elections.

recent_articles.title: BJP accuses Trinamool of misusing judicial process out of political desperation - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Supreme Court** declined to intervene in a Calcutta High Court decision regarding the deployment of central government officials for vote counting in West Bengal, prompting accusations from the **BJP** that the **Trinamool Congress** was using the judicial process for political gain.  **BJP** spokesperson Sudhanshu Trivedi claimed the **Trinamool Congress** was resorting to desperate measures due to anxiety about a violence-free election in the state. He also criticized the actions of West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee, alleging she did not trust her own government employees and staff.

recent_articles.title: High drama in Punjab Assembly; Congress, Akali Dal allege CM Mann was drunk during House proceedings - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Opposition parties in Punjab, including the Congress and Shiromani Akali Dal, have accused **Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann** of appearing intoxicated during a session of the Vidhan Sabha.  They demanded an alcohol test and called for dope testing of all MLAs.  Congress leader Sukhpal Singh Khaira urged **Arvind Kejriwal**, the national convener of the Aam Aadmi Party, to take action against **Mann**. Rajya Sabha MP Swati Maliwal also accused **Mann** of being intoxicated at public events and demanded an alcohol test. The Congress Legislative Party has formally written to the Speaker requesting immediate alco-meter and dope testing of all members.  Finance Minister Harpal Singh Cheema refuted the allegations, calling them false and baseless.

recent_articles.title: ‘Weakening public faith’ vs. ‘justified stand’: legal experts divided over Kejriwal’s decision - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Members of the legal fraternity** offered differing opinions on **Arvind Kejriwal’s** decision to not appear before a Delhi High Court judge in the excise policy case.  Some lawyers argued that dissatisfaction with judicial orders should be addressed through established legal remedies, while others supported **Kejriwal’s** decision, citing potential bias and the need for due process. Senior advocate Sajan Poovayya criticized the move as withdrawing from due process, while advocate Gyanant Kumar Singh suggested it was a tactic to challenge the court's ruling after losing the case.  However, advocate Prashant Bhushan supported **Kejriwal’s** decision, arguing that his apprehension of bias is justified.

recent_articles.title: ​Gang of seven: On the AAP defections - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Seven** members of the **Aam Aadmi Party (AAP)** have merged with the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**, increasing the BJP's strength in the Rajya Sabha to 113 and exceeding the halfway mark for the National Democratic Alliance. This merger highlights the opportunism of AAP and its disregard for democratic institutions, as it follows a pattern of defections from other parties. The Supreme Court is currently reviewing the legality of this merger under the Tenth Schedule of the Constitution, which prohibits defection by elected representatives.

recent_articles.title: Rajya Sabha Chairman accepts merger of seven AAP MPs with BJP - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **C.P. Radhakrishnan**, the **Rajya Sabha Chairman**, accepted the merger of seven **Aam Aadmi Party (AAP)** MPs with the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**, increasing the BJP's strength in the Upper House to 113 and reducing AAP to three members. The move followed a significant political realignment in the Rajya Sabha on April 24th, when seven of the AAP's ten members joined the BJP. **Arvind Kejriwal**, the AAP national convener, criticized the BJP for betraying Punjabis.

recent_articles.title: Assembly elections 2026 LIVE: Leaders make last ditch efforts to woo voters in West Bengal - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** focused on the Matua community's citizenship concerns ahead of the final phase of West Bengal elections. **Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee** held a roadshow in her constituency, Bhabanipur, criticizing voter deletions and the Election Commission-appointed administration.  **Arvind Kejriwal**, former Delhi Chief Minister, joined the Trinamool Congress campaign in West Bengal. The Election Commission of India (ECI) announced a stringent security plan for the second phase of the elections.

recent_articles.title: BJP attacking Bengali culture, pride: Kejriwal; Modi won’t have his way in Bengal: Tejashwi - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Arvind Kejriwal**, former Delhi Chief Minister and convener of the **Aam Aadmi Party**, joined the Trinamool Congress campaign in West Bengal on Sunday, addressing three rallies in Kolkata and Howrah.  His visit coincides with the final days of campaigning for the second phase of the Assembly elections, scheduled to conclude Monday evening. The AAP recently experienced a setback as seven of its MPs switched to the **Bharatiya Janata Party**.

recent_articles.title: AAP no longer the same party, no one can work with Kejriwal, says Swati Maliwal - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Swati Maliwal**, a former **AAP** MP, accused her former party of changing its principles and becoming corrupt under the leadership of **Arvind Kejriwal**. She claimed that she was pressured to withdraw an assault complaint against **Kejriwal's** aide and that more leaders would leave the party.  **Maliwal** joined the BJP after alleging that **Kejriwal** has become a "common man" who built lavish lifestyles while running the Punjab government through "remote control."  **Sanjay Singh**, an AAP leader, said the party will seek disqualification of the seven defectors from the Rajya Sabha.

recent_articles.title: Election Commission, and not the BJP, seems to be fighting Trinamool in West Bengal, says Kapil Sibal - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kapil Sibal**, a senior Supreme Court lawyer and Rajya Sabha MP, criticized the **Election Commission of India (ECI)**'s actions in West Bengal ahead of the upcoming elections. He accused the **EC** and the **BJP** of working together to suppress the Trinamool Congress (TMC), alleging an "unconstitutional Emergency" and a disproportionate deployment of Central Armed Police Forces (CAPF).  Other opposition leaders, including **Arvind Kejriwal**, have also expressed concern over the situation.

recent_articles.title: Kejriwal asks people of Tamil Nadu not to vote for NDA, says BJP has captured AIADMK - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Arvind Kejriwal**, leader of the **Aam Aadmi Party**, criticized the **AIADMK** for bringing the **BJP** to Tamil Nadu, claiming it would lead to the dismantling of the party and a loss of progress. He warned voters against supporting the BJP or the AIADMK, stating that their policies would halt the good work being done by the **DMK** government in Tamil Nadu.  Kejriwal praised **M.K. Stalin**, the Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu, for his initiatives like the "Chief Minister's Breakfast Scheme" and monthly stipends for women and girls.

recent_articles.title: Poll bugle to fall silent across Tamil Nadu on Tuesday evening - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Political parties** in Tamil Nadu are concluding their intense campaigning ahead of the Assembly election on April 23rd.  Polling will begin at 7 a.m. that day, with all political functionaries and party workers not eligible to vote required to vacate the area by 6 p.m. on Tuesday. **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, **Rahul Gandhi**, and other prominent leaders from various parties have campaigned in the state, while the Chief Electoral Officer has outlined strict regulations for the period leading up to the election.  These include restrictions on public gatherings, vehicle usage, and the establishment of polling booths.

recent_articles.title: It’ a red-letter day, says Revanth; KTR blames BJP - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Following the defeat of the Women's Reservation Bill in Parliament, **Congress** and **Bharatiya Rashtra Samithi (BRS)** leaders praised opposition parties for uniting to block the controversial legislation.  **Rahul Gandhi**, **Mallikarjun Kharge**, and **A. Revanth Reddy** led the charge against the bill, with **K. T. Rama Rao** blaming the BJP for its failure. **Bandi Sanjay** accused the Congress of using the bill to weaken southern India, while **N Ramchander Rao** criticized the bill's defeat as a setback for women's empowerment.

recent_articles.title: Assembly Elections 2026 LIVE updates: Will resolve Gorkha issue in constitutional manner without dividing Bengal, says Amit Shah - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Amit Shah**, **Union Home Minister**, stated that the BJP will address the Gorkha issue in the Darjeeling hills through constitutional means, without dividing West Bengal. **Rahul Gandhi**, Congress leader, accused the BJP and the RSS of destroying the Constitution with their "hate-filled thinking" while criticizing the TMC for failing to fulfill its promises regarding job creation.  **Arvind Kejriwal**, AAP national convener, is scheduled to visit Tamil Nadu on April 20, 2026, to support DMK and CM M.K. Stalin's campaign.

recent_articles.title: Kejriwal seeks Justice Sharma’s recusal in excise case; Centre calls plea ‘contemptuous’ - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Arvind Kejriwal**, former Delhi Chief Minister, requested the **Justice Swarna Kanta Sharma** of the Delhi High Court to recuse herself from hearing the CBI's appeal in the excise policy case.  Kejriwal argued that a "real, grave and reasonable apprehension" of bias existed due to the judge's attendance at events organized by the **Akhil Bharatiya Adhivakta Parishad**, a lawyer's body with ideological ties to the BJP-RSS. The **Centre** opposed the recusal application, calling it "contemptuous" and urging dismissal with costs.  Solicitor General **Tushar Mehta** argued that allowing such applications would set a dangerous precedent and undermine judicial impartiality.

recent_articles.title: Punjab: Special session on sacrilege law an attempt by AAP Government to cover up its failures, says Congress chief - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Amrinder Singh Raja Warring**, **Bhagwant Mann**, and the **AAP Government** in Punjab are at odds over a proposed law to punish sacrilege.  The **Punjab Congress** president criticized the special session called by the AAP government, claiming it is an attempt to distract from their failure to punish those responsible for previous sacrilege incidents. Warring also questioned the sincerity of the AAP's intentions and accused them of using the issue as a political tool. He further pointed out that the law lacks any real deterrent effect without proper punishment.

recent_articles.title: Kejriwal appears in person before HC to plead change of Bench in excise case; SG terms it ‘theatrics’ - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Arvind Kejriwal**, former Delhi Chief Minister and leader of the **Aam Aadmi Party (AAP)**, appeared before the **Delhi High Court** to argue for a change in the Bench hearing the CBI's plea against his discharge and that of 22 others in the liquor policy case.  **Tushar Mehta**, Solicitor General representing the CBI, objected to the application, arguing it was frivolous and contemptuous. He also stated that seven individuals had filed applications seeking a different Bench, suggesting a "well thought out design." The court is scheduled to hear the matter on April 13th.

recent_articles.title: 1.5M top-tier students, 200,000 seats: Why UK universities are spending millions to expand to India | World News - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **India** has the largest youth population in the world, with approximately 40 million students enrolled in universities.  Nine UK universities are establishing campuses in India following announcements made by **Sir Keir Starmer**, aiming to tap into this growing market. These institutions include the University of York, University of Aberdeen, and University of Bristol, offering programs at a lower cost than studying abroad while maintaining UK academic standards. While the move could potentially reduce student reliance on foreign universities, it remains to be seen if it will significantly impact enrollment rates in the short term.  However, these campuses are expected to create significant economic opportunities for both **British** and **Indian** institutions.

recent_articles.title: York, Southampton: UK universities flock to India - but will they succeed?
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **UK universities** are expanding their presence in India, aiming to capitalize on the country's growing student population and demand for quality education.  The **University of York**, among nine other institutions, is opening a campus in Mumbai with plans to recruit around 270 students initially. These campuses will focus primarily on business, management, and engineering programs. While the move offers potential benefits for both UK universities facing financial pressures and Indian students seeking higher education, success hinges on factors like affordability, program quality, regulatory compliance, and infrastructure development. The long-term impact of these domestic campuses remains to be seen, but they are expected to contribute modestly to the UK's economy.

recent_articles.title: Kerala Assembly polls 2026: CPI(M), Congress accuse each other of fragmenting ‘LDF-UDF duopoly’ in Kerala by aiding BJP - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **CPI(M)** and **Congress** leaders have accused each other of attempting to undermine the traditional Left Democratic Front (LDF)-United Democratic Front (UDF) duopoly in Kerala.  **V.D. Satheesan**, leader of the opposition, alleged that the **CPI(M)** is aiding the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) by fielding an independent candidate in Palakkad to split minority votes. **Ramesh Chennithala**, a senior Congress leader, claimed this is just the tip of the iceberg and that the BJP has also influenced other constituencies through puppet candidates.  **Pinarayi Vijayan**, Kerala's chief minister, criticized the Congress for its alleged self-defeating strategies in Delhi and Haryana elections, suggesting it seeks to undermine the national alliance against the BJP.

recent_articles.title: Punjab official death case: Former AAP Minister’s arrest triggers credit war - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Laljit Singh Bhullar**, a former **AAP** minister in Punjab, was arrested on Monday for the alleged suicide of Gagandeep Singh Randhawa, district manager of the Punjab Warehousing Corporation.  The arrest followed pressure from opposition parties, including the Congress and BJP, who demanded a CBI inquiry into the case. **Amit Shah**, Union Home Minister, reportedly indicated support for a CBI probe. The **AAP** government claimed swift action against its own minister in pursuit of justice.

recent_articles.title: A true benevolent authoritarian enforces discipline for the greater good: Seeman - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Seeman**, leader of the **Naam Tamilar Katchi (NTK)**, discussed his party's election manifesto and leadership style in an interview with The Hindu. He advocated for a shift towards an agriculture-centered economy, emphasizing the need to prioritize food security and self-sufficiency while potentially regulating harmful industries.  He also addressed concerns about the NTK's ideology, stating that it is not aligned with Dravidian parties and advocating for a more inclusive approach. **Seeman** expressed his belief in "benign authoritarianism" as a means of achieving order and stability, contrasting this with the perceived excesses of freedom without discipline.
